minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE MEETING
  SPECIAL MINUTES
  October 10, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, October 10,
2019, at 2:17pm in the Community Room A, 1sth Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Debra Crenshaw, City Treasurer’s Office

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee. Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to
address the Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Special Meeting held
on September 26, 2019.

Item #1:  City of Inglewood, Parks and Recreation to host Halloween Carnival
  Haunted House at Rogers Park 400 W. Beach Ave, on October 18, 19, 25,
  26 and 31, 2019 from 5:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m.; 2 uniformed IPD officers with
  2 marked police vehicle for public safety and high visibility; IPD Watch
  Commander will be notified and extra patrol requested (as time permits);
  person directing traffic is required to wear highly-visible retro-reflective
  vests; Maintain site and ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately after
  the event; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; and
  adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations
  and local, state and federal laws. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00277286)

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:19 pm.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
